cases.purpose: Preserve all account files after a later oversized group rewrite fails under RLIMIT_FSIZE.
cases.oracle: Byte-for-byte copies and original modes of all three private files; an independent size-limit control establishes EFBIG.
cases.comparison: Failure status, exact byte and mode preservation; syscall trace must confirm which replacement failed before treating this as a rollback proof.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
set -u
mkdir db snap
chmod 700 db snap
printf 'carol:x:1003:1003:Carol:/home/carol:/bin/sh\n' > db/passwd
printf 'carol:!:19000:0:99999:7:::\n' > db/shadow
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'f=open("db/group","w"); f.write("carol:x:1003:\n" + "staff:x:50:carol\n" + "".join("g%d:x:%d:%s\n"%(i,2000+i,"x"*120) for i in range(100))); f.close()' || exit 125
chmod 600 db/shadow
cp -a db/. snap/
( trap '' XFSZ; ulimit -f 4; /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import errno,resource,os; assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE)[0] == 4096; f=os.open("control",os.O_CREAT|os.O_WRONLY|os.O_TRUNC,0o600); os.write(f,b"x"*4096);
try: os.write(f,b"y")
except OSError as e: assert e.errno == errno.EFBIG
else: raise SystemExit(1)
os.close(f)' ) || exit 125
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/db/passwd PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/db/shadow PHCLIB_GROUP=$PWD/db/group BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0
( trap '' XFSZ; ulimit -f 4; passwd delete carol ) >out 2>err; rc=$?
[[ $rc != 0 ]] || exit 1
for f in passwd shadow group; do cmp -s db/$f snap/$f || exit 2; [[ $(stat -c %a db/$f) == $(stat -c %a snap/$f) ]] || exit 3; done
printf 'failure preserved all files and modes\n'
cases.stdout: failure preserved all files and modes

cases.purpose: Delete an account while preserving a same-named group used by another account and removing supplementary membership.
cases.oracle: Independent literal private passwd/group/shadow records and userdel semantics for shared primary groups.
cases.comparison: Exact group and account rows, preserving another account and membership.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=db/shadow BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0

cases.purpose: Inject EIO at each account-file rename for add and delete and verify byte, mode and residue rollback.
cases.oracle: Pinned seccomp notification log proves the exact failed rename; independently copied private account files provide byte and mode oracles.
cases.comparison: Each operation must fail, match all original file bytes and modes, and leave no temporary files; missing injected failure exits as an observation error.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=$PWD/db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/db/shadow BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
for operation in add delete; do
 for step in 1 2 3; do
  /usr/bin/rm -rf db snap
  /usr/bin/mkdir db
  /usr/bin/cp orig/passwd orig/group orig/shadow db/
  /usr/bin/chmod 600 db/shadow
  /usr/bin/cp -a db snap
  case $step in 1) replies=EIO;; 2) replies=continue,EIO;; 3) replies=continue,continue,EIO;; esac
  log="$HOME/rename-$operation-$step.log"
  if [[ $operation == add ]]; then cmd='passwd add-fd dave 3 -u 2005 3<pw'; else cmd='passwd delete carol'; fi
  /usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify rename --reply-seq "rename=$replies" --log "$log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd" >"$HOME/result.out" 2>"$HOME/result.err"
  rc=$?
  /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open(sys.argv[1])]; i=int(sys.argv[2])-1; assert len(a)>i and all(x["reply"]=="continue" for x in a[:i]) and a[i]["reply"]=="errno:5"' "$log" "$step" || exit 125
  [[ $rc != 0 && $rc != 125 ]] || exit 1
  for f in passwd group shadow; do
   /usr/bin/cmp -s "db/$f" "snap/$f" || exit 2
   [[ $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a "db/$f") == $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a "snap/$f") ]] || exit 3
  done
  for f in db/.[!.]* db/..?*; do [[ ! -e $f && ! -L $f ]] || exit 4; done
  printf '%s-rename-%s=unchanged\n' "$operation" "$step"
 done
done
cases.stdout:
add-rename-1=unchanged
add-rename-2=unchanged
add-rename-3=unchanged
delete-rename-1=unchanged
delete-rename-2=unchanged
delete-rename-3=unchanged

cases.purpose: A parent-directory fsync error after rename restores the old shadow record for set, lock and expire.
cases.oracle: Pinned seccomp notification log proves the second fsync fails; byte and mode copies independently check all private files.
cases.comparison: Operation status must be nonzero and all database bytes and modes unchanged with no temporary-file residue.
cases.script:
[[ $EUID == 2000 && $PWD == /tmp/parity-case && $HOME == /tmp/parity-home ]] || exit 125
IFS= read -r v </sys/class/dmi/id/sys_vendor || exit 125
IFS= read -r u </etc/bashos-parity-vm || exit 125
[[ $v == QEMU && $u =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-[0-9a-fA-F]{12}$ ]] || exit 125
export PHCLIB_PASSWD=$PWD/db/passwd PHCLIB_GROUP=$PWD/db/group PHCLIB_SHADOW=$PWD/db/shadow BASHPASSWD_KERNEL_SECRETS=0 PHCLIB_M=1024 PHCLIB_T=1 PHCLIB_P=1
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
for operation in set lock expire; do
 /usr/bin/rm -rf db snap
 /usr/bin/mkdir db
 /usr/bin/cp orig/passwd orig/group orig/shadow db/
 /usr/bin/chmod 640 db/shadow
 /usr/bin/cp -a db snap
 case $operation in set) cmd='passwd set-fd alice 3 3<pw';; lock) cmd='passwd lock alice';; expire) cmd='passwd expire alice 19500';; esac
 log="$HOME/fsync-$operation.log"
 /usr/bin/python3 "$H" --notify fsync --reply-seq fsync=continue,EIO --log "$log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd" >"$HOME/sync.out" 2>"$HOME/sync.err"
 rc=$?
 /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; a=[json.loads(x) for x in open(sys.argv[1])]; assert len(a)>=2 and a[0]["reply"]=="continue" and a[1]["reply"]=="errno:5"' "$log" || exit 125
 [[ $rc != 0 && $rc != 125 ]] || exit 1
 for f in passwd group shadow; do /usr/bin/cmp -s "db/$f" "snap/$f" || exit 2; [[ $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a "db/$f") == $(/usr/bin/stat -c %a "snap/$f") ]] || exit 3; done
 for f in db/.[!.]* db/..?*; do [[ ! -e $f && ! -L $f ]] || exit 4; done
 printf '%s-parent-sync=unchanged\n' "$operation"
done
